capabilities: Create, rename, and delete CSS snippets in the snippets directory
Edit CSS files with syntax highlighting and code completion
Open, create, or delete snippets from a quick-switcher-style modal
extras: Basic VIM editing support and mobile support are mentioned; the quick switcher modal uses modifier keys (Enter, Tab, ⌘Enter) to change actions.
intentEvidence: edit CSS files in the .obsidian/snippets/ directory, with syntax highlighting and code completion, no external editor required
problem: Editing CSS snippets normally requires leaving Obsidian for an external editor, and Obsidian offers no built-in way to manage snippet files directly.
summary: In-vault CSS editor that lets you create, edit, rename, delete, and toggle snippets in .obsidian/snippets/ with syntax highlighting.
